name: Neon Slot Rush
shortDescription: A fast, mobile-first 5x3 neon slot machine with paylines, turbo, and auto-spin.

suggestion.prompt: Design a modern, highly addictive, mobile-first slot machine with 5x3 reels, paylines, configurable symbols, RNG outcomes, balance/bet/win display, turbo and auto-spin, dark neon theme, and concise paytable/help.

improvements.description: Added per-payline win breakdown list with click-to-highlight: after each spin, each winning payline appears as a clickable row showing symbol, payline number, match count, and payout amount; clicking a row highlights only that payline's cells on the reels.

Added toggleable visual payline overlay: a Lines On/Off button draws all 10 paylines as colored SVG polylines over the reels using getBoundingClientRect positioning; each payline has a distinct neon color and numbered label. Also enhanced the paytable with a formula header (Win = Multiplier x Matches x (Bet / $5)) and a per-symbol grid showing dollar payouts at x3, x4, and x5 matches.
Changed the Lines toggle to cycle through individual paylines (Line 1–Line 10), All Lines, and Off, so each payline can be viewed in isolation to follow a winning line.

Win result clicks now sync the payline display mode (clicking Payline N sets Line N; clicking All winning lines sets All Lines). Added a quick-off button (✕ Off) that appears whenever a payline is active, letting the user turn off the overlay without cycling through all modes.

generation.notes: Built from approved community suggestion issue #198; optimized for 320px portrait and keyboard/touch parity.
